verdict.rationale: Better Stack documents a REST API with per-endpoint human-readable references and curl examples. However, nothing in the pack shows a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent machine-readable spec, and the probe found every common OpenAPI/Swagger path returning 404. The per-endpoint HTML docs, the markdown docs page and the Terraform integration are adjacent to this story, not a machine-readable API spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
